name: school-identity-vault
description: Verifiable Learning Records for Displaced Children

scripts.install-all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../ml-engine && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm start" "cd ml-engine && python -m uvicorn src.main:app --reload"
scripts.test: concurrently "cd backend && npm test" "cd frontend && npm test" "cd ml-engine && pytest"

author: School Identity Vault Team
